claims.text: MOA: lincosamide, primarily bacteriostatic; binds the 50S ribosomal subunit (inhibits protein synth).
claims.quote: Clindamycin is a lincosamide antibiotic that is primarily bacteriostatic. It binds to the 50S subunit of the ribosome, thus inhibiting bacterial protein synthesis.

claims.text: Spectrum: anaerobes (⍉reliably Bacteroides) and most community-acquired MRSA;
claims.quote: Effective for infections due to anaerobes (except not reliably active against Bacteroides species, including Bacteroides fragilis, because of resistance), most community-acquired methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, and macrolide-resistant, clindamycin-susceptible Streptococcus pneumoniae

claims.text: aerobic gram (-) bacilli and enterococci are resistant.
claims.quote: Aerobic gram-negative bacilli and enterococci are resistant.

claims.text: For CA-MRSA skin infect, usefulness depends on local resistance patterns.
claims.quote: Clindamycin can be used for infections (eg, skin and soft-tissue infections) in communities where community-associated methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (CA-MRSA) is common; whether clindamycin is useful depends on local resistance patterns.

claims.text: Boxed warning: C. difficile infect, mild diarrhea to fatal colitis;
claims.quote: Clostridioides difficile infection (CDI) has been reported with use of nearly all antibacterial agents, including CLEOCIN HCl and may range in severity from mild diarrhea to fatal colitis.

claims.text: reserve for serious infect where less toxic drugs are inapprop.
claims.quote: Because CLEOCIN HCl therapy has been associated with severe colitis which may end fatally, it should be reserved for serious infections where less toxic antimicrobial agents are inappropriate
Due to the risk of esophagitis and esophageal ulcer, it is important to ensure adherence with administration guidance
CLEOCIN HCl is contraindicated in individuals with a history of hypersensitivity to preparations containing clindamycin or lincomycin.

claims.text: Caution w a Hx of GI dz, esp colitis.
claims.quote: CLEOCIN HCl should be prescribed with caution in individuals with a history of gastrointestinal disease, particularly colitis.
Clindamycin has been shown to have neuromuscular blocking properties that may enhance the action of other neuromuscular blocking agents.

claims.text: CYP3A4/5 substrate: inhibitors may raise and inducers lower clindamycin levels.
claims.quote: Therefore, inhibitors of CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 may increase plasma concentrations of clindamycin and inducers of these isoenzymes may reduce plasma concentrations of clindamycin.

claims.text: Take capsules w a full glass of H2O and ≥30 min b4 lying down.
claims.quote: Administer CLEOCIN HCl Capsules with a full glass of water (6 to 8 ounces, approximately 200 to 250 mL) and at least 30 minutes before lying down to reduce the potential for esophageal irritation
